title: Suturing vs Biological Adhesive in Simple Lacerations of Hand
brief_summary: To assess the difference in clinical outcome between lacerations in the hand treated by sutures versus treated by tissue adhesive.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Any age
* Hand laceration distal to the volar wrist crease.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Fracture , tendon, artery involvement, more than 8 hours from laceration to trx,
* Immunosuppression
* Anticoagulation therapy
* Diabetes
* Unable to achieve homeostasis in more than 15 minutes
* Unwilling to participate in the study
* Unable to participate in the follow up or bite of any kind.
